findings.title: Untrusted HTML stored and served as raw (stored XSS); url interpolated unescaped
findings.body: Imported feed or remote content is saved with cook_method raw_html and Post#cook returns raw unsanitized. It is rendered with `raw post.cooked`. Scripts in feed content therefore execute on the forum, and the url is interpolated into an href without escaping. Sanitize the content, for example with Sanitize, and escape the url.

findings.title: Invalid ERB `end if` breaks the template
findings.body: `<%- end if %>` is a Ruby syntax error (`end` followed by a dangling `if`). The view will not compile, so embed/best fails whenever a topic exists. Use `<%- end %>`.

findings.title: embed_url enqueued without host validation; unauthenticated callers can trigger work
findings.body: Any request whose Referer matches the embeddable host (the Referer is trivially forged by non-browser clients) enqueues a retrieve job for an arbitrary embed_url. The job validates the host later, but this still lets anonymous callers enqueue jobs at will. Validate the embed_url host before enqueueing.

findings.title: open(url) with user-influenced URL (SSRF / local file / command)
findings.body: Kernel#open with a URL string allows SSRF to internal hosts. A leading pipe would run a command, but the host check blocks that in the retriever path. The Disqus import passes t[:link] from an XML file straight in. Use a restricted HTTP client and validate the scheme.

findings.title: Weak origin check using indexOf
findings.body: `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1` accepts any origin that is a substring of discourseUrl, including an empty string (the origin of a sandboxed or data: frame). Compare for equality against the origin.

findings.title: Controller can leave @topic_view nil or render incorrectly
findings.body: best.html.erb calls @topic_view.topic.url in the header even when posts are empty. When the topic is found but has no posts, @topic_view is used as is. The `<%- end if %>` in best.html.erb is also a syntax error (`end if`), so the view fails to compile.

findings.title: Mutating contents with << changes the sha1 and fails on frozen strings
findings.body: `contents <<` mutates the caller's string, and may raise on frozen strings. The hash is computed after the suffix is appended, which is fine. But absolutize_urls output is what gets stored, and revision compares only against the hash.

findings.title: Unescaped referer injected into inline JS
findings.body: request.referer is client-controlled and is emitted in a script string with ERB HTML escaping, not JS escaping. A crafted referer containing a quote or backslash sequence breaks out of the string. The referer must match the embeddable host by the controller check, but the path and query are unconstrained. Use j(request.referer) or a fixed origin.

findings.title: Disqus import changed and category option removed
findings.body: The --category option was removed, and imports now call import_remote, which fetches each URL over HTTP. The topic is no longer created with created_at, and the call is not covered by the request. A dry run is unaffected, but real imports now need network access and depend on embeddable_host settings.

findings.title: open() on admin-configured URL without scheme check
findings.body: Kernel#open on a setting value permits local paths or pipe commands, and any URL. Restrict to http(s) and use a proper client.

findings.title: Missing content crashes the poll; scrub on nil
findings.body: Feed items without a content element have i.content nil, so `.scrub` raises NoMethodError and aborts the whole poll. Skip such items or fall back to description.

findings.title: Non-atomic setnx + expire
findings.body: If the process dies between setnx and expire, the key never expires and that URL is never retrieved again. Use set with ex and nx options.
